newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Persetel says in talks, cautions holders.
newsitem.headline: Persetel says in talks, cautions holders.

text.p: Persetel Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it was in talks to buy a Brazilian information technology company.
It said the acquisition, if succesfully concluded, would not exceed U.S.$100 million and would be funded by means of internal cashflows and borrowings.
It said negotiations would be concluded shortly after the due diligence investigation -- expected to be completed on March 28.
Shareholders were urged to exercise caution in their share dealings until a further announcement was made shortly after the due diligence investigation.
